dictionary: Sorted training-partition categories only; absent or unseen=-1; no arbitrary magnitude ordering
primary: Raw context-categories versus raw frozen 27-feature baseline on all 6 windows and all 48 dates
secondary: Raw/calibrated stock-ID and context arms, seen/naturally-unseen stocks and exchange groups; no parameter search or cohort selection
baseline_choice: Original verified plan-value 96/8/12/8 cohorts have complete matched past-only industry snapshots. This isolates category input, not the recent-label schedule; combine only after evidence.
identity_limits: Exchange and coarse code family derive from canonical IDs, not current board names. SH68/SZ30 versus other A codes; historical Shenzhen SME/main combined. XBSE canonical identity may predate BSE establishment; not certified historical market membership.
industry_limits: Retrospectively reconstructed dated industry snapshots; original publication timestamps unverified; missing BSE industry retained
unseen_limits: Naturally new stock IDs only; no claim of randomized held-out-stock generalization or extrapolation if cohort sparse
promotion: No promotion from this development ablation. Require stable return/risk calibration and meaningful cost-stressed plan results with unknown coverage before combination or forward test. No sealed data or automatic trading.
